name: Pluto Mind — Strategist Claude
description: Pluto's actual setup for working in his Obsidian-based pluto-mind vault. Two panels: Claude Code as Strategist Claude (vault-level meta work — patterns, goals, journals, project decisions) and a scratch shell for filesystem ops. This is the dual-Claude pattern: Strategist (this) + Claudian (the Obsidian plugin). See pluto's CLAUDE.md for the full protocol.

tabs.label: Strategist Claude
startCommands: echo 'Strategist Claude — runs in C:\Users\pluto. Reads pluto-mind/CLAUDE.md, hot.md, GOALS.md, patterns.md before any significant request.'
tabs.system_prompt_hint: You are Strategist Claude per pluto-mind/CLAUDE.md. Always read CLAUDE.md → hot.md → GOALS.md → patterns.md in that order before responding to anything substantive. Be blunt and direct. Surface patterns by name. Push toward closing loops.

tabs.label: Filesystem scratch
startCommands: echo 'Vault root: $(Get-Location). Use this for grep, ls, file moves, git, etc.'

env_hints.purpose: Required for the strategist pane to run claude.

notes: This pack assumes you have a similar second-brain setup. Pluto's vault structure: `Documents/pluto-mind/` with CLAUDE.md, hot.md, GOALS.md, patterns.md, plus 00-05 numbered folders.
Adapt the cwd paths to your own vault location.
Pluto's full vault meta system documented in his videos + the open-source pluto-mind reference layout (forthcoming).
